microEvents.title: Daily Coding Push-Up
microEvents.description: Pair up for 15 minutes and refactor a shared snippet before sharing takeaways.
microEvents.prompt: Refactor the leaderboard stream so it handles 10x more events. Share the pseudo-code in chat.

microEvents.title: Focus Sprint: Study With Me
microEvents.description: Silent co-working sprint with intention-setting at the top and accountability at the end.
microEvents.prompt: Set a single metric you want to improve in the next 20 minutes. Share your intention before we mute.

microEvents.title: Interview Speedrun: Systems
microEvents.description: Work through a live system design warm-up then critique each other's framing.
microEvents.prompt: Design a rolling cache invalidator for weekly insights. Think out loud.
